newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products off with futures, long markets.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products off with futures, long markets.

text.p: NWE oil products were flat to weaker on Wednesday, tracking Brent futures and pressured by good supply.
Russian gas oil premiums gained about 50 cents while diesel premiums rose $1 or so. Softer futures, down 75 cents, eroded these gains.
Gasoline was flat to slightly easier with Eurograde barges for May delivery done at $197, while prompter material stood around $193/$194.
Naphtha was also slightly weaker in line with weaker crude prices and a fairly healthy supply in the region.
Fuel oil barges tumbled on very weak demand and aggressive selling. A low of $79.50 fob ARA was hit. A Tuesday cargo deal at $74.50 fob stabilised that grade.
